jyutping: jat1 seng1 bat1 hoeng2 gam3 V

english.note: Use this when the person leaves or acts without making any sound or announcement, not just without speaking.

examples.english: They packed their things and left wordlessly.
examples.traditional: 佢一聲不響咁執好啲嘢就離開咗。
